title: Provide short term credit only under ASIC's conditions
what: ASIC's product intervention order lets short term credit be provided to retail clients only under its conditions (limits on fees).

laws.title: ASIC Corporations (Product Intervention Order—Short Term Credit) Instrument 2022/647

sources.title: ASIC Corporations (Product Intervention Order—Short Term Credit) Instrument 2022/647
sources.quote: (1) A short term credit provider must not provide credit to a retail client under a short term credit facility except in accordance with the conditions in subsections (5) and (6).
